function.name: asm
function.description: Deterministic Addressable Semantic Memory (ASM) retrieval over a flat addressed store. ops: serve = rank + select units under a WORD budget (needs question + budget + store); list = every stored address in file order (needs store); inspect = resolve one address to verbatim text + word count (needs address + store). Ladder ops (expand) are reported as unsupported_op by this reference implementation, never approximated.

question.description: serve only: the task query, one line

budget.description: serve only: WORD budget (rule R4), never tokens

store.description: the addressed corpus: file path or inline units {address, text}

format.description: response format; default echoes the request format (json for csv)
